title: estimator-crossover-hardware: Sim-to-Silicon test of the estimator crossover on real hardware
description:
Firmware (ESP32, Arduino), analysis code and test protocol for testing on real hardware whether the estimator crossover found in simulation survives real sensor noise. A Kalman filter, an innovation-gated Kalman filter, a 2-mode IMM and a GRU estimator track a pendulum measured by a VL53L0X time-of-flight sensor, under proximity-coupled Gilbert-Elliott burst faults (inflated-variance, frozen and blended), physically caused faults, and real sensor lock-ups and latch-ups recovered by a protection circuit.

Status: code complete; hardware validation pending. No measured results are included in this version.
